exposure: Mild fasting hyperglycemia in the first trimester (FPG 5.1-5.6 mmol/L)
cohort: Pregnant women in their first trimester with fasting plasma glucose (FPG) levels between 5.1-5.6 mmol/L.
finding: Women with first-trimester fasting plasma glucose (FPG) levels between 5.1-5.6 mmol/L may warrant proactive management in early pregnancy.
country: Australia, New Zealand (based on publishing college)
